title: Kagamine Len — Uncontrollable Curiosity〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, do you know where KAITO is?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nope.
Ugh... Why's he gone at a time like this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, wanna try taking another look around?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's try searching together this time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Based on what MEIKO said, he's been spending time here lately to work on some mixes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, this song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's coming from over there! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There he is!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Hello, you two! As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Energetic?!
We looked all over for you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
For me?
Oh, does this mean the new dessert MEIKO was working on is finally ready...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No! Tell him, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay. The thing is, I saw this unbelievable show the other day!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: An unbelievable show?
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
So you actually got to see a video of the very event that Akito and the others are trying to surpass.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wish I could've also seen it. Why didn't you tell me sooner?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Finding Rin's one thing, but you're like a needle in a haystack.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. True.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that's not the whole story, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I haven't told you why I came to find you yet!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You've taught us a lot about music and being a DJ up until this point...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we want you to teach us those things more often.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is this because of what you saw?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All of us watching got completely sucked in right from the first song, and it was all over before any of us realized it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We were like, “Oh, it's over...”
But we had goosebumps everywhere because we just knew that we'd seen something absolutely amazing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I still can't really believe how good it was, and it really opened my eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It did?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. That video told me that I need to do more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito and the others are trying to surpass that, which is obviously going to be an impossibly hard challenge.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know that just wanting to sing with everyone won't be enough now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't get to see that video, but the fact is that Kohane's been improving at a daunting pace.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is why we need to do more to keep up with her and the others.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, so we want to learn more from you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Just trying something for a day or a few days won't cut it! We want to do more! A lot more!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Please, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We also promise to adjust our own practice schedules since we know we're asking a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's clear to me that you're serious about this...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So yes, I'll agree to help.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can we start today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, wait...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's still a chance that MEIKO's done working on that new dessert I mentioned earlier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we stop by her place for a quick break first?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Were you really listening to anything we were saying just now, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course. We can start...
Tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, way! That means you're not gonna help us at all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We know that you're a complete slob when it comes to anything not related to music!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're starting right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The cafe can wait until after we're done!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... It's like I'm the student now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Enough talk! Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
We can start right now.
